source_contract: For deterministic a<b and ANY actual real H strongly measurable in original Fa, actual finite residual vector TOGETHER WITH H is jointly independent of the SAME one-block increment under original P.
derivation_and_quantifier_review: Actual residual coefficient overlap(a,b,t)/(b−a) is computed from native covariance of SAME original B_t with B_b−B_a; denominator variance(b−a)>0 proved only for a<b.

Native Gaussian-process finite-linear-form interface constructs the single combined process: block increment, finite residual observations, ENTIRE original through-a path. Explicit finite sets implement each observation; no joint-Gaussian H premise.

Cross-covariance zero is proved for increment versus BOTH each residual coordinate and every original-past coordinate. Native Gaussian process independence therefore gives increment independent of the JOINT residual+past object; it does not infer joint independence from separate pairwise assertions.

The original naturalFa sigma is contained in the comap of that joint process via actual past coordinates; actual Fa-measurable H is measurable in the same joint sigma. Restricting the proved independence yields exactly (Rfinite,H) independent of increment.

Caller finite sets may include before/inside/after interval and0. Residual coordinates themselves need not be mutually independent. Arbitrary nonlinear H is permitted; no new controller information or chosen H introduced.
actual_reuse_decision: Old constant-terminal finite Gaussian regression does not by itself retain an arbitrary nonlinear START H together with residuals. New source directly reuses original covariance/finite Gaussian source and native IsGaussianProcess.of_isGaussianProcess/indepFun_of_covariance_eq_zero, with the larger actual Gaussian residual+wholepast construction. Generic random-parameter tilt is consumed in the successor.
scope_limits: This module requires strict a<b for regression division; same-time case is handled separately downstream.
No full shifted Brownian conclusion is claimed by this module alone.
actual_consumer_obligations: sin(B1) actual joint independence for arbitraryI and explicitI={0,1,3/2,2,3}
Actual overlap0 beforeSTART and1 afterEND; residual/increment covariance0 before/inside/after
